description: This file defines a NestJS controller for managing team conferencing applications within an organization, including connecting, listing, setting defaults, disconnecting, and handling OAuth callbacks.

classes.name: OrganizationsConferencingController
classes.description: NestJS controller handling organization team conferencing operations, including OAuth, listing, setting defaults, and disconnecting conferencing apps.

methods.name: connectTeamApp
methods.description: Connects a conferencing app to a team without OAuth.

methods.name: getTeamOAuthUrl
methods.description: Generates OAuth URL for conferencing app authorization.

methods.name: listTeamConferencingApps
methods.description: Lists conferencing applications associated with a team.

methods.name: setTeamDefaultApp
methods.description: Sets the default conferencing app for a team.

methods.name: getTeamDefaultApp
methods.description: Retrieves the default conferencing app for a team.

methods.name: disconnectTeamApp
methods.description: Disconnects a conferencing app from a team.

methods.name: saveTeamOauthCredentials
methods.description: Handles OAuth callback to save conferencing app credentials.
